test_title: PYST 52: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Substitute the underlined word-segment with most appropriate idiom.

The doctors tried __very hard__ to save his mother but they were unsuccessful.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"moved heaven and earth"** means to do everything possible to achieve something. (हर संभव प्रयास करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The team moved heaven and earth to meet the project deadline.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the doctors "moved heaven and earth" to save his mother, meaning they tried very hard.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Faced the music **(परिणाम भुगतना): To accept the unpleasant consequences of one's actions.

 
 
• **Example:** After failing to complete the project on time, he had to face the music in front of his boss.
 
 
 
• **Drew the line **(सीमा तय करना): To set a limit on what one is willing to do or accept.
 
 
• **Example: **She drew the line at working more than 50 hours a week.
 
 
 
• **Ran like clockwork **(बहुत सुचारु रूप से चलना): To operate very smoothly and efficiently, without any problems.
 
 
• **Example: **The event ran like clockwork thanks to the meticulous planning.
